svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Dominik (thaDoom). Full-stack web developer, self-taught, Veneto, Italy, on site or remote. Available now. From an empty folder to people using it. 475 tests green before the last deploy. 9 releases shipped in 10 days. Looking for a junior full-stack role. A 3D chart of the last year shows 45 days with a push out of 366.
